pages.title: Pet Connect
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Match colorful pet tiles across varied board layouts to clear puzzles and unlock new levels in this tile-connecting puzzle game. Using pattern recognition and spatial planning, players aim to link identical animals scattered throughout charming environments. Progressive difficulty introduces obstacles and limited moves, challenging players to optimize connections for higher scores and completion.

Key Features

• Tile matching mechanic variation  
• Drag and link pet icons  
• Increasing puzzle complexity  
• Time and move-limited modes  
• Animal-themed level environments

pages.title: Pet Salon Doggy Days
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description:
Manage pet grooming stations by timing wash and trim cycles to keep dogs happy and neat in this casual salon simulator. Players interact with various grooming tools through point-and-click mechanics while balancing customer requests and managing resource upgrades. The challenge centers on efficiently handling multiple pets under time constraints to maintain high satisfaction.

Key Features

• Timed grooming task sequences  
• Point-and-click tool usage  
• Customer satisfaction management  
• Incremental station upgrades  
• Canine care setting
